title: Woman in 1940s Suit & Hat, Vintage Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A sepia-toned full-length snapshot of a woman elegantly dressed in post-WWII 1940s fashion, wearing a structured tailored suit with pronounced shoulder pads, a matching skirt, white gloves, a fascinator hat, and holding a dark handbag with a coat folded over her arm. She stands outdoors near a wooden porch frame and a metal lattice lawn chair.
